description: This Java interface defines a common contract for all connectivity-related events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies constants, default method implementations, and nested classes for handling event data pertinent to connection state changes, including resource identification and JSON field definitions.

classes.name: ConnectivityEvent
classes.description: A generic interface for all connectivity-related events in the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing methods for resource identification, headers, and JSON schema definition.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection as a String, deprecated in favor of getConnectionEntityId.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ConnectionId object representing the unique identifier of the connection.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the event, defaulting to getConnectionEntityId.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the resource path within a JSON pointer structure; defaults to an empty path.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, fixed as 'connectivity'.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Always throws UnsupportedOperationException as connectivity events do not have revisions.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Method to set revision, unsupported for connectivity events, always throws.
